translations./garage/brief: Pick up at the town gate, stop at the power transfer station, and deliver to the market gate. Two patrol vehicles cross streets lined with wet pavement, gravel, and sand.
translations./prediction/heading: How Will You Run the First Delivery?
translations./prediction/hint: Record a prediction. It does not affect the score; the run will give you evidence to test it.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Read the phase: enter after the patrol vehicle passes
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Correct. Wait for cross traffic before entering Main Street, then inspect the waiting event and minimum clearance.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Wet pavement and sand turn excess power into wheelspin. Check energy use and odometry.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Put the patrol vehicle in the static map
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: The patrol vehicle moves. A static map represents buildings; prediction estimates where traffic will be next.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Entering town. Heading for the power transfer station.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: Patrol vehicle tracked. Predicting its path.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Three route segments, three driving approaches, one delivery. The town welcomes you.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find which badge was lost. The town route demands more than one driving approach.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
